lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Co2 (Mg6Co) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Co and Mg centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Co–Mg and Mg–Mg neighbor distances ranging from about 2.88 to 3.24 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies 12-vertex Mg and Co coordination polyhedra linked through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
